objective: Add a bounded cognitive Council between Ascalon proposals and the Floor Governance Cell using deterministic Instructor/Auditor checks and existing CognitiveRuntime advisory reasoning.
implementation: Typed FloorCouncil with explicit Instructor -> Advisor -> Auditor -> Synthesis -> Closed phase trace.
Instructor validates action graph reachability, floor/state freshness, proposer role, and evidence references.
Advisor is bounded to existing CognitiveRuntime and cannot mint authority.
Auditor validates trust and deterministic evidence constraints.
Council fail-closes on missing Advisor, stale proposals, untrusted inputs, deterministic boundary failures, or Advisor disagreement/low confidence.
Council reviews are persisted into the floor Blackboard and emitted as structured telemetry.
GuardianManager attaches a bounded Advisor contract to each governed floor.
AutonomousFactoryController wires CognitiveRuntime as that Advisor.
Objective contradiction evidence now preserves probe confidence and propagates it into final cognitive confidence.
Wave-4 focused and existing cognitive safety suites pass.
research: 2026 structured multi-agent debate research supports explicit moderators, role-specialized agents, and protocol-first deliberation.
AgentDojo remains an adversarial reference for stateful tool-using agents and indirect prompt injection.
The standalone LangGraph supervisor repository is archived; ShortForge did not add it as a dependency.
OpenAI evaluation guidance reinforces structured evaluation; ShortForge retains native deterministic evaluation infrastructure.
nonGoals: Automatic closure or execution from Council consensus
releaseNote: The validated executable head is followed only by documentation/Team/PR-description synchronization; runtime code must not be changed in that tail.
